name: ruflo-metaharness
description: MetaHarness integration for ruflo — surfaces score/genome/mint/mcp-scan/threat-model via skills; pairs with @metaharness/router (ADR-148/149) for cost-optimal model routing; honors ADR-150's architectural constraint that MetaHarness remains an optional augmentation, never a required runtime dependency. As a mod (ADR-445): confirms flywheel promotion, keeps secrets out of inputs, /metaharness-mod, and a status file the console shows

guard.title: Guard
guard.description: Refuse tool calls that are clearly harmful in this plugin's domain (see README, As a mod).
